snippet.title: DAIMON BLADES - GAMESCOM REVEAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Daimon Blades is a brutal first person slasher that combines the depth of action RPGs and replayability of roguelites. Launch expeditions solo or up to 4 players, and survive the many horrors of the Daimon Realm.

Available October 6 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1869500/DAIMON_BLADES/

Join the community on the official discord channel: https://discord.gg/streumon
